tasks.label: reset db
tasks.detail: Wipes database volumes and re-initializes all DDL table schemas from SQL scripts

tasks.label: start backend
tasks.command: cd schoolpro-backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
tasks.detail: Boots Django development server on http://localhost:8000

tasks.label: start frontend
tasks.detail: Starts Vite React 19 development server on http://localhost:5173

tasks.label: stop all services
tasks.command: docker compose -f schoolpro-db/docker-compose.yml down && (kill -9 $(lsof -t -i:8000) 2>/dev/null || true) && (kill -9 $(lsof -t -i:5173) 2>/dev/null || true) && echo 'Stopped all SchoolPro services (Docker DB, Backend :8000, Frontend :5173).'
tasks.detail: Stops PostgreSQL/pgAdmin containers and kills running Backend and Frontend servers

tasks.label: seed python
tasks.command: cd schoolpro-backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python manage.py migrate && python manage.py db_seed
tasks.detail: Runs 24-step Django Python management command db_seed to seed master data, roles, users, and infrastructure
